title: Local App QA report (frontend-qa / verifier verification result)
$comment: PHASE 2 CONTENT, transcription not invention. VERIFICATION_RESULT_SCHEMA was drafted as near-identical across two builtin workflows once planned for this plugin, tagged below as `local_app_build_workflow.js` (react_dom) and `local_app_canvas_workflow.js` (canvas/three/phaser/babylon) — neither file exists anywhere in this repo (grepped; zero hits). The plugin ships ONE unified build workflow instead, `lingxi-code/plugins/lingxi-local-app/workflows/local-app-build.js`, whose shipped `reportSchema` already carries this same shape (ok/findings/checked_matrix/browser_available/webview_checked/degraded_verification/data_roundtrip/render_check/motion_check/summary), enforced at that file's `blockingFindings`. The two drafted schemas differed in exactly the way design §11.2's Profile verification policy already documents in prose: DOM's render_check.status allows 'not_applicable' ('无 canvas 时 render_check.status=not_applicable 合法') and DOM has no motion_check property at all; the canvas family's render_check.status has no not_applicable branch and REQUIRES motion_check ('motion_check.frames_compared >= 2'). This file expresses that as one schema — render_check.status keeps the not_applicable option, motion_check is present but not in the top-level required list — with an documented profile-conditional requirement below, rather than inventing a merged shape design §18 Phase 4 has not settled. Only the reconciliation of which fields are unconditionally required is new, and it transcribes §11.2's prose rather than adding anything §11.2 does not already say.

findings.description: Unresolved defects that still need a source change, each with its evidence and the file to change. NOT a record of what was checked and NOT a summary — an entry here sends the app into a repair round. Empty when verification found nothing wrong.

data_roundtrip.description: Native persistence check. For a drawn surface that declares no collection this answers not_applicable, which is why render_check (not this field) is the canvas family's hard render gate — design §11.2.

render_check.description: canvas_surfaces keys on the PRESENCE of a canvas, not an empty DOM element list, per the shipped canvas render gate in lingxi-code/plugins/lingxi-local-app/workflows/local-app-build.js (`countAtLeast(report.render_check?.canvas_surfaces, 1)`); `local_app_build_workflow.js` does not exist in this repo. status=not_applicable is legal only for a DOM app with zero canvas_surfaces (design §11.2 DOM policy); the canvas family (§11.2 Canvas2D/Three/Phaser/Babylon policy) must never answer not_applicable and requires canvas_surfaces >= 1 and frames_captured >= 1.

canvas_surfaces.description: canvasCount from the last inspect-view call. Non-zero means the DOM path cannot see part of this app.

frames_captured.description: Frames actually returned by a capture-view call.

interactions_driven.description: Pointer/key actions actually driven, e.g. ["pointer 120,300 tap", "key ArrowLeft down"].

evidence.description: What was SEEN in the captured frames, in concrete visual terms. Naming the app or restating the spec is not evidence that it rendered.

motion_check.description: Proof the frame loop is actually running, which a single still frame cannot show. REQUIRED (design §11.2: 'motion_check.frames_compared >= 2') for canvas_2d/three_3d/phaser_2d/babylon_3d verification policy; absent for a DOM (react_dom) verification that has no embedded canvas. This property is intentionally NOT in this schema's top-level `required` list because that requirement is profile-conditional, not universal — see the shipped `countAtLeast(report.motion_check?.frames_compared, 2)` gate in lingxi-code/plugins/lingxi-local-app/workflows/local-app-build.js (`local_app_canvas_workflow.js` does not exist in this repo).

difference.description: What changed between two frames captured at different times, and after which input. "Nothing changed" is a FAILED motion check unless the app was deliberately paused.
